fields.description: RFID master switch. When off no RFID rule runs: no invoice checks, no stations, no scheduled alerts. Item codes and labels have their own switches on the other tabs.
fields.label: Enable RFID

fields.description: Off: only grouped sets need a counter read; single tagged garments may be billed by picking the serial.
fields.label: Every RFID-tracked unit must be read at an RFID counter before billing

fields.description: Piece/serial labels count as a read and are logged as Barcode Fallback exceptions.
fields.label: Accept printed labels when a tag cannot be read

fields.description: On: nothing can be sold unless it carries an RFID identity.
fields.label: Block stock items that are not RFID tracked

fields.description: RFID counters: picking an RFID item by hand (click or item barcode) asks the cashier to confirm the piece has no tag, and never allows more pieces by hand than the untagged stock (checked again at payment and on submit). Off: no such check.
fields.label: Check RFID items picked by hand against untagged stock
Allow sale when the tag will not read
fields.description: Every piece in stock carries a tag but this one's tag is damaged or missing: the cashier can still sell it by hand, with a reason. The tag left behind is kept as an Unread Sale until a stock count finds it.

fields.label: Manager approves unread-tag sales
fields.description: A user who does not hold the Manager Override station needs a manager's login and password at the counter.

fields.label: After A Sale
fields.options:
Free the tag at once
Free the tag after removal at the detach station
fields.description: At once: the tag is reusable as soon as the bill is paid. After removal: it stays linked to the sold garment until it is read at the detach station.

fields.label: Allow removing tags from unsold items
fields.description: On: users of the Tag Removal station (Station access below) can take a tag off an item that was not sold, on the Remove tags screen or in Tag history, and use it on another item. The item goes back to the to-tag list. Every removal is logged as a Tag Removed exception.
Raises a Missed Audit exception at 23:00 when no count was compared that day.
fields.label: Daily handheld count required

fields.description: Who may use each station. System Manager always can. A station with no rows is closed to everyone else.
fields.label: Station access
Build item codes and names from patterns
fields.description: Works with RFID switched off. Applies when an item is created with Item Code left blank, and to every new variant.

fields.label: Separator between words in a code
Supplier code length
fields.description: Used when the supplier has no Item Code Prefix: first letters of the supplier name.

fields.label: Max letters of item name in a code
fields.description: 0 = whole name.

fields.label: Tokens
fields.options: Tokens: {supplier_code} {supplier} {item_name} {item_group} {brand} {style_code} {template} {template_name} {attr_abbrs} {attr_values} {attr:Colour} (abbreviation) {value:Colour} (value) {###} (running number per prefix). Empty tokens are dropped together with their separator.

fields.label: Create a barcode for every new stock item
fields.description: Works with RFID switched off. Items that already carry a barcode (e.g. the supplier's) keep it.

fields.label: Barcode prefix
fields.description: EAN-13: 2x is the in-store range; use your GS1 company prefix if you have one.

fields.label: Prepare a Sticker Print Job when stock is received
fields.description: Purchase Receipt, Purchase Invoice with Update Stock, and Stock Entry receipts.

fields.label: Label Copies From A Document
fields.description: Enter by hand: items without serial numbers start at 0 copies and the user types how many stickers to print. Serial items always get one label per piece.

fields.label: Also print a label for each set piece
fields.description: Garment sets: one durable label per jacket/trouser/etc. so a return can be matched after tags are removed.

fields.label: Price list for label price
fields.description: Blank = Selling Settings default.

fields.label: Footer line
fields.description: e.g. store name. Blank = company name.

fields.label: Work out MRP on purchase rows
fields.description: Purchase Order / Receipt / Invoice rows get MRP = rate x (1 + GST %) x (1 + Margin %), rounded up. On submit of a Purchase Receipt or Invoice the MRP becomes the item's selling price and the rate its buying price; cancel puts the old prices back. Adds the columns to the purchase item tables.

fields.label: Round MRP up to a multiple of
fields.description: 10: 647 becomes 650. 1: rupees only.

fields.label: Offers on MRP
fields.description: Selling Item Prices get MRP and Offer %; the selling rate is MRP less the offer. Purchase rows carry the offer, labels print the MRP struck through with the offer price, and Item / Item list get Set Offer.

fields.label: Fill rows from Item Name and the item's tax
fields.description: Purchase rows with only an Item Name (Data Import) get the item with that name; rows without an Item Tax Template get one from the item's Taxes table even when its Tax Category is blank.

fields.label: Add Variants buttons
fields.description: Add Variants (all variants of a template in one go) and Update Template on purchase item tables.

fields.label: Keep numeric attribute ranges in step
fields.description: Saving a numeric Item Attribute copies its range into every item's attribute row, so the Multiple Variants dialog does not build a checkbox per number.
